description: Test file for kube-controller-manager controllers, including tests for controller name validation, feature gating, and controller startup behavior.

methods.name: TestControllerNamesConsistency
methods.description: Tests that controller names conform to naming conventions and suffix requirements.

methods.name: TestControllerNamesDeclaration
methods.description: Verifies that all known controllers are declared in the controller names list.

methods.name: TestNewControllerDescriptorsShouldNotPanic
methods.description: Ensures that creating new controller descriptors does not cause a panic.

methods.name: TestNewControllerDescriptorsAlwaysReturnsDescriptorsForAllControllers
methods.description: Checks that all controllers are included when feature gates are toggled.

methods.name: TestFeatureGatedControllersShouldNotDefineAliases
methods.description: Ensures controllers guarded by alpha features do not have aliases.

methods.name: TestTaintEvictionControllerGating
methods.description: Tests that the TaintEvictionController runs only when the feature gate is enabled.

methods.name: TestNoCloudProviderControllerStarted
methods.description: Verifies cloud provider controllers are not started when not configured.

methods.name: TestRunControllers
methods.description: Tests the shutdown behavior of controllers, including clean shutdown and timeout scenarios.
